name: PWM pad
description: Two pulse waves with slow pulse-width modulation from VCO 1 as an LFO. Wide, moving, chorus-like pad.
tidal: d1 $ n "<[0,4,7] [-3,0,4] [-7,-3,0] [-5,-1,2]>" # s "scstd" # o1lf 1 # o1lfrate 0.8 # o1lvl 0 # o2wave 1 # o2pwm 0.8 # o3lvl 0.6 # o3wave 1 # o3pwm 0.6 # o3oct 0 # o3fine (-0.08) # vcfcut 1800 # vcfres 0.2 # vcfenv 0.1 # aratk 0.4 # arrel 1.2 # erel 1.2 # legato 1
